lens: What named problem, platform strength or market gap does our concept answer?
look_for: A one-sentence problem statement and a core rule that changes what the player does; a design element that only this platform can deliver.
red_flags: Novelty that renames the usual verb; a concept that would be the same on any platform; a crowded genre chosen from trend data.

lens: Can a novice finish with only the core, and does the optional depth reward veterans?
look_for: A playthrough with only the basic verbs reaches the end; depth systems and extras sit where players choose them; the harshest penalty suits the target player.
red_flags: Progress gated by the depth system; extras forced on everyone; risk tuned to the team's skill.

lens: Given our team, tools and remaining time, is this a concept we can finish, and what does our situation make uniquely possible?
look_for: Dev time estimated for each candidate; carried-over team, tools and assets listed; the plan uses that head start boldly.
red_flags: A concept chosen without a time estimate; a one-time opportunity left unused.

lens: Do our characters, stages or vehicles change the rules, or only the art?
look_for: Each variant is a parameter set that changes how it plays and sounds; players can name favorites and say why.
red_flags: Reskins with barely different stats; separate code per variant.

lens: Has the final balance been checked on production hardware after the last optimization?
look_for: Processing speed and timing locked before tuning; difficulty and timers replayed on retail units; a narrow fix ready if launch reveals a problem.
red_flags: Tuning only on dev boards; optimizations after balance sign-off; game speed tied to processing speed.

lens: Before cutting a feature or content, have we tried changing its context or using the limit as a design idea?
look_for: Screen space, arena bounds, speed, camera and roles tried as levers; memory and screen limits answered with reuse, authored patterns or bigger targets.
red_flags: Signature mechanics cut at the first balance problem; limits treated only as subtraction.

lens: For a sequel, what is the one-line headline, and does every element have an upgrade target?
look_for: A headline tied to new hardware, audience or team continuity; an element-by-element upgrade list.
red_flags: 'More of the same' at the same scale.

lens: If players or partners don't get the game, where can they learn why it is deep?
look_for: A players' guide or regular explanation in the words of whoever knows the game best.
red_flags: Waiting for the press to explain a new concept.
